queries.name: lineitem-distinct-part

queries.name: lineitem-distinct-part-supplier

queries.name: h09-output-distinct
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey,l.l_partkey,l.l_suppkey FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey=l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp x ON x.ps_partkey=l.l_partkey AND x.ps_suppkey=l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey=l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey=l.l_suppkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey=s.s_nationkey WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%green%')

candidate_space: All connected left-deep orders with the opaque Part predicate kept first; no bushy orders or operator substitution
cost_model: Sum of exact bag prefix cardinalities; does not by itself price index construction, key width, or cache effects
